answer: Shared Fate Credentials. Each agent gets a distinct credential seed and publishes a signed usage trail; a duplicate identity reuses seeds that collide in a public plume of attestations. On collision, both profiles freeze pending review, and the attacker must rebuild an independent history plus a fresh collateral deposit for each copy. Watching nodes publish contradictions to a shared reef of signed logs, making copies (an oasis of apparent diversity) collapse into one visible cost sink.
